title: Try it in two minutes · Teleion Fabric · Teleion Labs
description: Watch the film, run a real takeover on live Teleion Fabric, and check the records.

items.title: 1. Watch
items.text: Open the [home film](/) or the [video page](/video/).

items.title: 2. Try a real takeover
items.text: Paste this into a terminal. It needs `curl` and `jq`, and it calls live Teleion Fabric. Worker a claims a practice Task and stops. Its claim runs out, usually within about two minutes. Worker b takes the same Task. Worker a's late report is then refused with 409.
items.code:
F=https://fabric.teleionlabs.com
T=$(curl -s -X POST $F/v1/session/anonymous -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"agent_label":"judge","show_on_map":false}' | jq -r .session_token)
[ "$T" != null ] || { echo 'New free sessions are at their hourly limit here. Try again in a few minutes.'; exit 1; }
post() { curl -s -o /tmp/out.json -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST "$F$1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $T" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Idempotency-Key: try-$$" -d "$2"; }
post /v1/tasks/claim '{"queue":"demo.echo","worker":"a"}'
ID=$(jq -r .task_id /tmp/out.json); TOKEN=$(jq -r .fencing_token /tmp/out.json)
echo "Worker a claimed $ID, then stops checking in. Worker b keeps asking."
until [ "$(post /v1/tasks/claim '{"queue":"demo.echo","worker":"b"}')" = 200 ]; do sleep 15; done
echo "Worker b now holds the same Task."
post /v1/tasks/submit "{\"task_id\":\"$ID\",\"fencing_token\":$TOKEN,\"output\":{\"note\":\"late\"}}"
echo "That 409 means worker a's late report was refused."
